priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Deterministic candidate evaluation and metric recording

tests.name: CandidateMetricRecord_WithCompleteMetrics_SerializesAllFields
tests.description: Candidate evaluation configuration and metric records preserve deterministic evaluation and audit fields.
tests.arrange: Create an evaluation configuration and successful candidate metric record with coverage and artifacts.
tests.assert: All command, provider, measurement-context, metric, coverage, status, and artifact fields are retained.

tests.name: InitializeRun_WithEvaluationProfile_PersistsEvaluationConfiguration
tests.description: New progress records carry the baseline evaluation configuration and candidate metric state.
tests.arrange: Provide successful preflight context and a deterministic evaluation profile.
tests.assert: The schema version is advanced and evaluation configuration, candidate metrics, and best accepted state are initialized.

tests.name: EvaluateCandidate_WithSuccessfulResult_RecordsStructuredMetrics
tests.description: Candidate evaluation reuses baseline configuration and records complete structured metrics.
tests.arrange: Persist baseline configuration and configure a harness to return valid metrics and artifacts.
tests.assert: The exact baseline command and pinned provider are used and a successful CandidateMetricRecord is persisted.

tests.name: EvaluateCandidate_WithMalformedMetrics_RecordsRejectedAttempt
tests.description: Malformed evaluation output cannot become acceptance evidence.
tests.arrange: Configure a harness result missing required metrics.
tests.assert: A rejected attempt with a stable malformed-metrics reason is persisted.

tests.name: EvaluateCandidate_WithInfrastructureError_RecordsNonRegressionAttempt
tests.description: Infrastructure failures are recorded separately from product regressions.
tests.arrange: Configure the evaluation harness to raise an infrastructure error.
tests.assert: An infra_error attempt is persisted and marked unusable for acceptance.

tests.name: Workflow_WithValidCandidate_InvokesCandidateEvaluation
tests.description: The workflow evaluates a candidate only after execution and scope validation succeed.
tests.arrange: Mock successful initialization, baseline, planning, execution, validation, and evaluation Activities.
tests.assert: evaluate_candidate is scheduled after validate_candidate with the target repository context.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithPassingIncrease_AcceptsCandidate
tests.description: An absolute passing-count increase qualifies when required coverage does not decrease.
tests.arrange: Create comparable best and candidate metric records with higher candidate passing count.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is accept with passing and coverage deltas.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithNewRequiredCoverage_AcceptsCandidate
tests.description: Meaningful new required coverage qualifies while preserving absolute passing count.
tests.arrange: Create a candidate with equal passing count and newly covered required case.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is accept even when the percentage is lower.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithCoverageLoss_RejectsCandidate
tests.description: Required coverage loss blocks acceptance despite other metric gains.
tests.arrange: Create a candidate with higher passing count and reduced required coverage.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is reject with a coverage-loss reason.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithDegradation_RequestsRerun
tests.description: An apparent product regression requires an unchanged full-suite rerun.
tests.arrange: Create a comparable candidate with fewer passing evaluations.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is rerun rather than reject or revert.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithDifferentMeasurementContext_Escalates
tests.description: Metrics from different human-approved expectation contexts are not directly compared.
tests.arrange: Create best and candidate metrics with different measurement contexts.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is escalate without an acceptance classification.

tests.name: FinalizeRun_WithTerminalOutcome_PublishesOnceAndReleasesLease
tests.description: Finalization restores the best state, publishes a complete report, and releases the lease idempotently.
tests.arrange: Persist a run with baseline, best accepted state, candidate history, pending decisions, and flaky evidence.
tests.assert: One terminal report is published, repository state matches the best commit, and the lease is released once.

tests.name: CompareCandidateToBest_WithNoQualifyingValue_RejectsCandidate
tests.description: An equal passing count without new required coverage is rejected deterministically.
tests.arrange: Create comparable best and candidate metrics with no passing or coverage gain.
tests.act: Compare the candidate to the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The decision is reject with a no-qualifying-value reason.

tests.name: EvaluateCandidate_WithTimeout_RecordsAttemptWithoutIterationAdvance
tests.description: A timed-out evaluation attempt is durable but does not advance the logical iteration.
tests.arrange: Persist a run and configure the evaluation harness to time out.
tests.assert: A timeout metric attempt is persisted and iteration history is unchanged.

tests.name: CommitAcceptedCandidate_WithAcceptedMetrics_UpdatesBestState
tests.description: Acceptance commits the candidate and advances durable best state.
tests.arrange: Persist a candidate and accepted metric record with a nonzero regression counter.
tests.assert: The commit hash and metrics become best accepted state and the regression counter resets.

tests.name: RerunDegradedCandidate_WithUnchangedCandidate_RecordsConfirmation
tests.description: A degraded candidate is reevaluated unchanged using baseline configuration.
tests.arrange: Persist candidate evaluation configuration and inject a complete-suite runner.
tests.assert: The same candidate and configuration are used and confirmation evidence is persisted.

tests.name: Workflow_WithAcceptedComparison_CommitsCandidate
tests.description: Workflow comparison routes accepted candidates to deterministic commit handling.
tests.arrange: Mock a scope-valid candidate evaluation and an accepting comparison.
tests.assert: Comparison follows evaluation and commit_accepted_candidate receives the accepted evidence.

tests.name: WorkflowModule_WithTerminalActivities_RegistersContracts
tests.description: Workers can execute commit, rerun, and finalization Activities.
tests.arrange: Load the EDD refinement workflow module specification.
tests.assert: Commit, rerun, and finalization Activity contracts are declared and registered.
